scope: Compatible edited-input preservation in a new standalone run document

contracts.cli: runner refresh source destination, optionally with --target; no target import or execution
contracts.original: Retain the source document/results and target bytes; fresh document uses inputs.context, preserved limits and null results
contracts.catalog: Added, removed, changed, retained and unresolved source comparisons; absence in incomplete catalogs never proves removal/addition; compare type/root schema/certainty while keeping source locations separate; plain contexts have an unknown baseline
contracts.migration: Preserve exact roots verbatim; changed same-name records copy matching typed fields, same-rank/identity arrays copy logical coordinate overlap, joints copy common axes and strings copy only when they fit
contracts.missing: New or incompatible leaves remain missing; no numeric conversion, variable-owner rename, robot model or bank capacities inferred
contracts.context: Retain removed/unrelated context, values, partial data, comments and services; changed root creation metadata remains in the original document
contracts.status: Recompute binding/requirement snapshots from edited values; unresolved discovery remains explicit; no successful execution or readiness guarantee
contracts.provenance: Immediate previous-target identity and source-document path/hash, without recursive refresh history; no authenticity claim
contracts.publication: New output only, protected source/target aliases, source byte check and new target pin; failed publication preserves the original; single writer required
contracts.interruption: Reject unresolved running markers; no automatic retry or use of output results as inputs
contracts.limits: Existing input/discovery/document bounds; second status pass cannot materialize roots skipped by the first shared storage budget
